topics.title: El Niño raises the stakes at COP31
topics.summary: A powerful El Niño pattern is adding urgency to COP31 discussions, with scientists warning it could intensify disruptive weather while delegates debate climate finance and resilience.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your town had one year to prepare for more unpredictable weather, what practical project would you start first?

topics.title: Wild oysters return off Scotland
topics.summary: Conservationists are restoring native oysters off Scotland's north-east coast, bringing shellfish back after local extinction and creating habitat that can support wider marine life.
topics.discussionPrompt: Oysters quietly filter water and build reefs. What small, overlooked creature deserves more credit for helping its whole neighborhood?

topics.title: Italy fines Meta over photo access
topics.summary: Italy's data protection authority fined Meta €805 million after finding that its Facebook app accessed Android users' photos, videos and related data without specific consent. Meta says it will appeal.
topics.discussionPrompt: What is one phone permission you would happily give an app, and one you would always want to think twice about?

topics.title: Philippines wins inaugural Eurovision Asia
topics.summary: Carmelle Collado's pop-and-rap song Sobra-Sobra won the first Eurovision Asia contest in Bangkok, marking the competition's first regional edition outside Europe.
topics.discussionPrompt: For a friendly neighborhood song contest, would you go for a big anthem, a funny novelty tune, or a quiet song with a great story?

topics.title: Eco buildings put design and climate together
topics.summary: A global architecture roundup highlights projects using ideas such as locally sourced timber, natural cooling and adaptive reuse to show that lower-impact buildings can still feel distinctive.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you rather live in a timber tower, a breezy brick courtyard, or a thoughtfully reused old building? What would make it feel like home?

topics.title: Welsh landscapes become an immersive show
topics.summary: The National Library of Wales has animated paintings by Sir Kyffin Williams and set them to music, using an immersive exhibition to introduce his rugged landscapes to new audiences.
topics.discussionPrompt: If one artist's world could become a walk-through experience, whose colors, places, or characters would you want to step inside?

topics.title: Starship reaches the launch pad again
topics.summary: SpaceX's Starship test program completed another launch and return sequence, advancing its reusable-rocket work even as engineers continue refining landing and recovery systems.
topics.discussionPrompt: Reusable rockets are a spectacular version of a simple idea. What everyday thing would you redesign to be easier to repair and reuse?

topics.title: AI helps unlock Gödel's notebooks
topics.summary: Researchers are using AI tools to help decipher Kurt Gödel's dense shorthand notebooks, making previously difficult mathematical material more accessible to scholars.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a stack of old notebooks could be decoded instantly, whose notes would you most want to explore: a scientist, artist, relative, or inventor?

topics.title: Microsoft outage tests digital backups
topics.summary: A broad Microsoft outage disrupted services including Teams and Outlook before the company reported restoration, prompting another reminder of how dependent offices and public services are on shared platforms.
topics.discussionPrompt: When your usual apps stop working, what low-tech backup saves the day: paper notes, a phone call, a second service, or simply a pause?

topics.title: AI's physical side means more metals
topics.summary: As data centres grow, analysts are focusing on the copper, steel, rare earths and grid connections behind AI computing, alongside questions about energy demand and infrastructure planning.
topics.discussionPrompt: The cloud still needs wires, buildings, and power. Which invisible piece of everyday technology would you be most curious to see behind the scenes?
